finding: Verified behaviour: 'Edit draft' and 'Manual' opened the same read-only preview; the only difference was the manual flag on the logged reminder. Definitions: Edit draft = this cycle's scheduled reminder; Manual reminder = an extra reminder outside the schedule (logged as manual, does not advance the cadence); Log as Sent = record the (edited) text as sent for this claim — use after copying into your mail client (or use 'Proceed & send' on the card to send via n8n); Skip This Cycle = record that no reminder was sent this cycle, schedule unchanged.
